recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, two-part composition featuring a wide off-white header with minimalist sans-serif typography and a lower photographic panel depicting a man in a dark suit walking past life-sized ice sculptures on a tiered architectural background.
coreVisualRelationships: The vertical line in the header aligns with the edge of the architectural steps below.
The dark silhouette of the man contrasts against the pale, horizontal lines of the siding.
The transparency of the ice sculptures echoes the cool, desaturated tones of the background.
coreInvariants: Large off-white negative space at the top
Horizontal division between text and image

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The human subject is positioned in the lower-left quadrant of the photographic panel, scaled to approximately one-third of the panel height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The three ice sculptures on the right provide a heavy, translucent visual anchor that balances the dark figure on the left.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the top-left text, follows the vertical line down into the photographic scene, and moves left-to-right across the figures.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive use of negative space in the top 40% of the frame creates a sense of airy sophistication.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the dark suit and the pale surroundings.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used in different positions and line breaks for hierarchy.
graphicDevices: Thin vertical hairline rule separating text blocks

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the clean, mid-century modern aesthetic and weight.
Provides the geometric circularity seen in the counters.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a photographic scene in the bottom 60% of the frame. A man in a 1970s black suit and sunglasses walks left-to-right past three life-sized ice sculptures of men. The background is a white-walled building with horizontal siding and concrete steps. The top 40% of the image must be a solid, flat off-white color.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a thin vertical line in the center-left. Place hairline sans-serif text in the top left and just to the right of the vertical line, using a stacked layout for the secondary text.

verificationChecks: Is the top section a clean, solid off-white?
Are the ice sculptures translucent and life-sized?
Is the font weight extremely thin?
Is the vertical line aligned with the architectural elements?

adjustableVariables: Text alignment relative to the vertical rule
mustRedesign: Artist names and specific titles must be replaced with generic placeholders
Any specific brand logos on the clothing or background

mustAchieve: Precise alignment of graphic and photographic elements
avoid: Heavy shadows that obscure the ice transparency

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text does not overlap the photographic panel.
Verify the ice sculptures look like carved ice, not glass or plastic.
Check that the man's suit is a deep, matte charcoal or black.
Confirm the vertical rule is perfectly straight and thin.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a minimalist header with a surrealist, low-saturation photographic panel, connected by a single vertical graphic rule.
